title: CWP/3356/2025 of TARSEM SINGH Vs UNION OF INDIA AND ORS
text: 180 IN THE HIGH COURT OF PUNJAB AND HARYANA AT CHANDIGARH CWP-3356-2025 and other connected cases Date of Decision: September 24, 2025 TARSEM SINGH ........Petitioner Versus UNION OF INDIA AND ORS ........Respondent CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE HARKESH MANUJA Present: Mr. Satbir Rathore, Advocate for the petitioner(s). Mr. Bhupender Singh, Advocate for Mr. Rishi Kaushal, Advocate for respondent Nos.1 and 2. Mr. Athar Ahmed, DAG, Punjab. HARKESH MANUJA, J. (ORAL) Vide this common order, four writ petitions shall stand disposed of, details of which are mentioned in the foot of the judgment. For convenience, facts are taken from CWP-3356-2025. Four separate sets of replies have been filed on behalf of respondent Nos.1 and 2, the same are taken on record. Copies supplied. Learned counsel representing respondent Nos.1 and 2 informs that approval with respect to balance payment of solatium and interest has been sought from the Regional Officer, NHAI, Chandigarh on 22.09.2025 and the same is expected to be received within 2 weeks from today. He submits that the amount shall be deposited with respondent No.3 within a week thereafter. Learned State counsel informs that within 10 days of deposit of amount by NHAI, the same shall be released in favour of petitioner(s). I agree to specified portions of this document CWP-3356-2025 and other connected cases -2In view of the undertaking extended on behalf of learned counsel for respondent Nos.1 and 2, the present petition(s) is disposed of. It is made clear that in case respondent Nos.1 and 2 fail to deposit the balance amount of solatium and interest in the account of respondent No.3 within 3 weeks from today, respondent No.2 shall be liable to pay cost of Rs.1,00,000/- to the petitioner(s) from his own pocket which shall be recoverable as arrears of land revenue by District Magistrate, Hoshiarpur with immediate effect. In case, there is any default on the part of respondent No.3 in disposal of such amount to the petitioner(s), respondent No.3 shall be personally liable to pay cost of Rs.1,00,000/- from his own pocket. Pending application(s), if any, shall also stand disposed of. 24.09.2025 (HARKESH MANUJA) Tejwinder JUDGE Case No. Title CWP-3359-2025 RESHAM SINGH V/S UNION OF INDIA AND ORS CWP-3361-2025 SUKHWINDER KAUR V/S UNION OF INDIA AND ORS CWP-3391-2025 NIRMAL SINGH V/S UNION OF INDIA AND ORS I agree to specified portions of this document
